# Common project guidance

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [context.md](../context.md), the [approved scientific protocol](../docs/experiment_protocol.md), [interfaces](../docs/interfaces.md), [team responsibilities](../docs/team_responsibilities.md) and the relevant owner README before changes. Follow the authority hierarchy in the protocol; do not create a separate methodology.

Respect DELTA/DEVGRU/SAS ownership, explicit feature allowlists, matched observation keys, past-only history, train-only preprocessing, validation-only tuning and test isolation. Target-day stockouts are evaluation metadata only. Distinguish approved science from draft contracts, pending implementations and historical results. Flag conflicting instructions; preserve archives and follow the human's bounded task and Git constraints.
